//: Declares what every file beside it already is. The browser reads <script type=module> and needs nothing, but node infers a .js file's format from the nearest package.json and without this treats these as CommonJS, refusing the first export keyword it meets. The whole JS suite therefore passed or failed depending on which node was first on PATH. It is scoped to this directory on purpose: at the repo root it would also reclassify emscripten's generated go_model_cli.js, which really is CommonJS, and break tests/module_parity.
